_what: Where a page may have this computer upload a file for it (read-data/guarded-upload.mjs, run by the Workshop row tool:upload-a-file-to-a-signed-slot). The page cannot send a local file anywhere itself (the browser's cross-origin rules forbid it), so it asks this program, handing over a signed storage slot (an address and the form fields the storage service signed). The program uploads only to a destination a row here names: https, exactly that host, a path inside that row's folder, no query, no credentials, no port, at most max_fields fields, and a content type the row lists. The file is read from the one folder the person granted this tool (read-a-folder) and the page never sees it, only its size. A new destination is a new row; an empty list uploads nowhere.

words.no_such_hold: That file is not held (it was sent, or its {minutes} minutes ran out).
words.not_https: The upload address must be https.
words.bad_address: The upload address has a query, credentials, a port or no host, so it was not used.
words.host_not_allowed: This computer does not upload to {host}.
words.path_not_allowed: The upload path is outside the folder this computer allows for {host}.
words.too_many_fields: The upload form has {count} fields; at most {max} are allowed.
words.bad_field: The upload form field {name} is not text.
words.type_not_allowed: This computer does not upload files of type {type} to {host}.
words.too_big: The file is {bytes} bytes; at most {max} are held.
words.refused: The storage service refused the upload ({status}).
words.no_folder: No folder is granted to this tool, so there is no file to upload.
words.outside_folder: {file} is not a file inside the folder granted to this tool.
words.no_such_file: {file} is not a file in the folder granted to this tool.
